description: PLATFORM-FIDELITY-01b Diamond Princess corrective rerun: the PLATFORM-FIDELITY-01 DP pair's dedicated arm only, replayed with the function-matched union exempt_work_zones (data/config/protocols_covid_pf_dp_01b.json) so the same quarantine exemption policy resolves on the event-faithful diamond_princess hull. Theta 7.9e6, seeds 20200205-20200224, infection_age_days 6.8, imports 1 — frozen. The proxy arm's 20 PF-01 cells are reused unchanged (preflight probe: union list is inert on mega_cruise_5000, exempt counts identical to PF-01); the corrected contrast pairs those cells against the 20 rerun dedicated cells. Pre-registered sensitivity measurement; no Theta selection, no canonical-platform crowning.
base_overrides_note: The boxed crew-mess configuration, verbatim from covid_crew_mess_01_design.json arm sect_mess_boxed (the DP believability operating point per docs/covid/covid_dp_replay_handoff_2026_10_09.md section 2), applied by the 01b cell worker after prepare_cell_run_spec. Identical to the PF-01 DP design; only protocols_path differs.
cells_note: 1 theta x 1 infection_age x 1 imports x 2 arms x 20 seeds = 40 enumerated cells; the campaign submits only the dedicated_diamond_princess block (20 cells) — the proxy block is satisfied by reuse of the PF-01 cells (campaign/covid_platform_fidelity_01/ dp_t7e6_proxy), per the addendum's execution-count resolution and baseline-equivalence evidence.
cell_payload_additions_note: The PF-01 payload set, unchanged. The crew_window witness blocks carry the 01b preflight evidence: at_activation and at_end working_crew_count / working_crew_by_posted_zone, boxed service_deliveries active epochs, and crew_meal_service mode — the repaired exemption policy is verified per cell, not assumed.

arms.note: First arm so empty overrides per the arm grammar. Rides the scenario's declared proxy platform mega_cruise_5000. NOT resubmitted in 01b: the PF-01 proxy cells (same seed list, same theta, union list proven inert on this hull) are the baseline of record.

Same cell on the event-faithful diamond_princess hull (159 zones, 57 AHUs; PR #1167) with the amended union exempt_work_zones. The only difference from the baseline arm is catalog.platform_id plus the protocols file named by protocols_path.

metrics: paired hull delta: per-seed dedicated - proxy recorded_onsets (takeoff-conditional: seeds where BOTH arms record >= 10 onsets), median delta with q05-q95 — q05-q95 are seedwise spreads, NOT confidence intervals
P(takeoff) per hull: fraction of the 20 seeds with recorded_onsets >= 10
unconditional onset burden per hull: median and total recorded_onsets across all 20 seeds regardless of takeoff gate
takeoff-conditional asymptomatic share of lab_confirmed per hull
CRN pairing diagnostic: Pearson correlation of recorded_onsets across the two arms over both-takeoff seeds (rho < 0.3 -> unpaired analysis declared)
failed-comparison audit: any cell whose protocol engine fired a close_zones protocol is a FAILED COMPARISON, reported, never deleted
freeze.minimum_detectable_effect: 30% of the proxy arm's takeoff-conditional median recorded_onsets, declared at prereg review
report_immediately: any cell where a close_zones protocol fired (FAILED COMPARISON)
the paired delta's q05-q95 interval excluding zero — a seedwise spread, not a confidence interval; do not conclude platform equivalence from an interval crossing zero
